title: Exits command
description: Take-profit and stop-loss on what is already held (decision 0011 d15): `attach` (POST /api/v1/exits) on a futures position or on an order placed by gcx, `edit` (POST /api/v1/exits/{id}/edit), `cancel` (POST /api/v1/exits/{id}/cancel). Every number is a decimal string. The take-profit and stop-loss block is the order form's (order-command.schema.json#/$defs/bracket), every field of it. The runtime deduplicates on requestId, reads the position fresh, and validates with its own last price: a level already crossed is the warning trade.msgImmediateStop, sent anyway through `overrides`. Mirrors src/runtime/api/contract.ts (ExitsCall). New API/MCP exits default to one year independently of panel Settings (MH481); a duration is limited to one year (MH484, HTTP 400 beyond it); a Custom date more than a year after the entry's expiry is the overridable warning trade.bracket.msgExpiryTooLong (HTTP 422 until named in overrides), and one before it is HTTP 400. See docs/trading/tp-sl.md.

requestId.description: Caller-minted id (the panel uses a UUID); the runtime answers the same request once.

overrides.description: Keys of the warnings the caller sends anyway: the order form's overridable warnings and the two of a DCA bot on the coin (RULINGS 65). Errors cannot be overridden.

attach.description: Attach a take-profit and stop-loss. On a position: one per account and coin, sized from the position and following it as it changes (reduce-only as `bracket.reduceOnly` says, default true whatever Settings say, MH 520; existing exits retain it); the answer `{id}` names the exits (`x1`, ...). On an order of gcx's: open, partly filled or filled, not a bot's, not an exit; sized from what it filled; the exits take the order's id.

order.description: The order's id, as the orders topic gives it.

edit.description: Edit TP/SL: the whole block again. Targets are positional: target i of the block is take-profit i, filled ones included, in their place; a take-profit or stop-loss that was cancelled has left the block and is never made again unless sent as a new one. A filled target is never sent again; the rest are re-sized from what is still held. `bracket.reduceOnly` absent: an order's TP/SL keep what they have; sent: it wins; a position's keep the choice made at attach (MH 520).

cancel.description: End every take-profit and stop-loss of these exits that is still working.
